R0 ablation | N = 16,384; data blocks = 4,096 B; uniform workload; five paired runs per cell.
2,048 warmup + 4,096 measured requests; bars show mean and 95% t intervals.
All protocol bytes included. Steps are conditional and not additive; parameter retuning also changes tree geometry.
